ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the test, indicating possible issues such as slow server response time, large page size, or render-blocking resources. It is recommended to investigate and optimize these factors to improve the page's performance.
insights: Optimizing TTFB and FCP can significantly improve user experience, as faster server response times and content rendering can make the page feel more responsive and engaging.
Minimizing the number of render-blocking resources can help reduce load times and improve user experience.
Regularly monitoring and optimizing web performance can help maintain a fast and responsive website, which can positively impact user engagement and conversion rates.
